item.netheroverhaul.rift_key.desc: Use to unseal Nether portals to the Overworld.
item.netheroverhaul.rift_key.hint: Found whole in altars and ruins, or assembled from four rift shards.
item.netheroverhaul.rift_shard.desc: A cracked piece of the seal. Four, around crying obsidian, make a Rift Key.
item.netheroverhaul.rift_seeker.desc: Points toward the nearest watched structure and leaves a trail of soul flames.
item.netheroverhaul.rift_seeker.sneak: Sneak-use to choose what it seeks.
item.netheroverhaul.recall_charm.desc: Returns you to your Nether spawn camp. Grants a short fire resistance and slow falling.
item.netheroverhaul.sealed_flask.desc: Fills cauldrons. Places water if this Nether allows it.
item.netheroverhaul.glowstone_berry.desc: A snack of light. You glow, and you can see in the dark. Mature roots shed glowstone dust.
block.netheroverhaul.quick_soul_sand.des: Darker than soul sand, cracked with soul light. Swallows you like cobweb.
message.netheroverhaul.locked: The Overworld is sealed. Find a Rift Key, or assemble one from four rift shards.
message.netheroverhaul.unlocked: The rift opens. You can leave the Nether.
message.netheroverhaul.already_unlocked: The Overworld is already open to you.
message.netheroverhaul.recall_none: No spawn camp is bound to you yet.
message.netheroverhaul.flask_cauldron: Use this on a cauldron. Open water still boils away here.
subtitle.netheroverhaul.sealed: The Overworld will not take you back
subtitle.netheroverhaul.locked: A Rift Key will open the way
command.netheroverhaul.where_sealed: The Overworld rift is still sealed.
